title: Chiles Rellenos
subtitle: battered stuffed peppers with cheese filling
excerpt: Large green peppers are roasted, stuffed with melted cheese, dipped in egg batter, and fried until golden. This is a classic Mexican dish that takes a little effort but rewards you with something special.
sourceNotes: Chiles rellenos are a traditional dish from the state of Puebla in Mexico. They are one of the signature recipes in Mexican cuisine and are often eaten at festivals and family celebrations.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Roast and peel the peppers a day ahead. Store in the fridge.

content.text: Charring the peppers directly over a gas flame (or under a hot grill) until the skin is completely black makes peeling easy and adds a smoky depth. Be patient with the peeling -- leaving any charred skin gives a bitter taste.

items.prepNote: use 4 large poblano peppers -- roast over a flame or under a grill until the skin is charred all over, then steam in a covered bowl for 10 minutes and peel
use 200g mozzarella or Oaxacan cheese, cut into batons

content.text: Char the peppers all over until the skin is blackened. Place in a bowl and cover tightly for 10 minutes to steam.
Peel off the charred skin carefully. Make a slit along the side of each pepper and remove the seeds. Leave the stem on.
Stuff each pepper with a baton of mozzarella. Press the edges gently to close.
Dust each stuffed pepper lightly with flour. Shake off the excess.
Separate the eggs. Whisk the whites to stiff peaks. Beat the yolks with the salt and fold into the whites.
Heat oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Dip each pepper in the egg batter to coat.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden. Drain on kitchen paper and serve immediately.

items.cause: Pepper is wet or flour dusting skipped
items.fix: Dry the peeled pepper with kitchen paper before dusting with flour. The flour helps the egg batter adhere.

items.cause: Pepper not properly closed or too much filling
items.fix: Use a toothpick to secure the opening if needed. Do not overstuff.

items.cause: Egg whites not beaten to stiff peaks
items.fix: The whites must be beaten until they hold firm peaks. Fold the yolks in gently to keep the air in.

content.text: Chiles rellenos are one of the most celebrated dishes in Mexican cuisine. They are said to originate in the city of Puebla, which is also famous for mole poblano. The dish appears at family celebrations and religious festivals across Mexico. The cheese-stuffed version is the most common, though meat fillings are also traditional.
